sections.title: Application
sections.content: This reimbursement policy applies to all Medicare Advantage products and for network provider services reported using the UB04 and CMS 1500 form or its electronic equivalent or its successor form.

children.title: Overview
children.content: This policy describes the reimbursement methodology for influenza testing which is considered for reimbursement when billed with designated conditions.

children.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
children.content: NOTE: Procedure codes appearing in policy documents are included only as a general reference tool for each policy. They may not be all-inclusive.

children.title: Diagnostic Testing
content: UnitedHealthcare will consider reimbursement of the following influenza testing procedure codes when billed for any of the conditions listed below:

a. Abdominal Pain b. Acute bronchitis c. Acute sinusitis d. Acute tonsillitis, laryngitis and tracheitis e. Asthma exacerbation f. Chest pain g. Cough h. Dehydration i. Fatigue j. Fever k. Gastritis, unspecified, without bleeding l. Headache m. Infectious mononucleosis n. Influenza o. Nausea, vomiting p. Pharyngitis q. Shortness of breath r. Upper respiratory infection s. Viral infections t. Viral intestinal infection, unspecified u. Viral or bacterial pneumonia v. Whooping cough
UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of the influenza testing procedure codes above for any other conditions.

children.title: Viral Culture Testing
children.content: UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of viral culture testing for influenza. Procedure Code(s) 87254

children.title: Serology Testing
children.content: UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of serology testing for influenza. Procedure Code(s) 86710
